page: Amazon Web Services g7.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance features 96 physical Intel x86_64 CPU cores with dedicated allocation, 1 thread per core, and a base clock speed of 3.9 GHz. System memory totals 384 GB, providing 4 GB of RAM per CPU core. Hardware acceleration is delivered by 4 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPUs with a combined total of 128 GB VRAM.

For high-speed local data access, g7.24xlarge incorporates 3800 GB of attached NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 350 Gbps. The instance includes 0 complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The underlying hardware design combines high CPU core counts with dedicated processing resources, fast local NVMe storage, and substantial GPU memory capacity to execute parallel processing workloads without multi-tenant cpu contention.

By packing 4 discrete GPUs, 128 GB of VRAM, 96 physical Intel cores, 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and 350 Gbps network throughput into a single server, g7.24xlarge delivers significant compute density. This minimizes inter-node latency for scaling dense workloads. The instance is suited for graphics-intensive rendering, AI model inference, spatial computing, video processing pipelines, and parallel data workloads.
